rules.title: RSO annual allowable rent increase of 3% (July 1, 2025 – June 30, 2026)
rules.requirement: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance may receive an annual rent increase of no more than 3% for the period July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); RSO status can be checked at zimas.lacity.org.
rules.exemptions: Non-RSO properties are not covered by this figure; tenants are referred to the Housing Department for allowable increases.
rules.interaction: The page notes that state law separately requires 30 days' written advance notice for rent increases of less than 10%; it does not say the RSO displaces any state rule.
rules.extraction_note: The stated 3% figure applies only through June 30, 2026, which is before the query date of 2026-10-01. The page, retrieved 2026-10-01, gives no figure for the period beginning July 1, 2026. The RSO framework itself remains in force, but the 3% value may no longer be current. The page gives no specific ordinance section number, building cutoff, or exemptions.

rules.title: RSO: no additional percentage increase for utilities
rules.requirement: Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords of RSO units can no longer add any additional percentage increase for utilities on top of the annual allowable rent increase.
rules.key_value: Utility add-on percentage eliminated as of 2026-02-02
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.extraction_note: The page gives no ordinance number or enactment date for the change.

rules.title: RSO and SCEP fee pass-through surcharges
rules.requirement: Landlords may pass through the RSO fee ($1.61 per month) and the SCEP fee ($2.83 per month) to tenants, in addition to rent. They may do so only after registering the units and giving the tenant written notice.
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO); Systematic Code Enforcement Program (SCEP)
rules.quoted_span:
The SCEP and RSO surcharges are separate and in addition to the rent amount and can only be collected after the
landlord registers the units and gives written notice to the tenant.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO).
rules.extraction_note: The SCEP fee amount is stated as effective January 1, 2022, and the RSO fee amount as effective January 1, 2020. Because the two components have different dates, effective_date is left blank.
